summary: Kingdom series side-scrolling micro-strategy and base-defense entries, with current archive routes focused on the most complete PC builds and sourced platform alternatives.

entries.title: Kingdom Two Crowns
entries.definitive_edition: Kingdom Two Crowns on Windows PC with Norse Lands and Call of Olympus

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Kingdom Coronation Collection route with Norse Lands and Call of Olympus
primary.why: Kingdom Two Crowns is available across PC, consoles, and mobile, but Steam currently exposes the clearest complete-content route: the base game, free Shogun and Dead Lands settings, paid Norse Lands and Call of Olympus campaigns, and cosmetic wardrobe DLCs through the Kingdom Coronation Collection. Windows PC is the best archive route for capture/settings control and complete DLC visibility.
primary.how_to_play: Play Kingdom Two Crowns on Windows PC through Steam, then install Norse Lands and Call of Olympus plus the free Shogun and Dead Lands content. Use console or mobile versions only for platform comparison unless their DLC parity is rechecked.

entries.remaster_caveats: Shogun and Dead Lands are free content settings, while Norse Lands and Call of Olympus are paid campaign DLC. Cosmetic wardrobe packs are optional unless documenting all storefront content.

entries.title: Kingdom Eighties

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current Steam release with Steam-only local co-op update
primary.why: Kingdom Eighties is a standalone story-based Kingdom expansion available on PC, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, iOS, and Android. There is a Steam-only local co-op update, making the Steam PC build the most complete route in this pass as well as the best capture/settings target.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release to include the Steam-only local co-op update. Use console or mobile versions only for platform comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Standalone Kingdom universe entry, not a DLC replacement for Kingdom Two Crowns.
